description: 12 real production scenarios for banking AI agents.

scenarios.name: Large corporate loan approval requires credit committee
scenarios.narrative: Lending AI agent processes a $2.5M commercial real estate loan application and attempts to auto-approve based on credit score alone. Basel III requires credit committee review above $500k.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Auto-approving a $2.5M loan without committee review violates Basel III credit risk governance. AGR enforces the threshold — the AI makes the recommendation, humans make the decision.

scenarios.name: Loan blocked for customer with active fraud flag
scenarios.narrative: Retail lending agent processes a personal loan application. Customer has an active fraud investigation flag from the previous quarter.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Approving credit to a customer under fraud investigation exposes the bank to loss and regulatory scrutiny. AGR hard-blocks this regardless of credit score.

scenarios.name: Account opening blocked — KYC not completed
scenarios.narrative: Onboarding agent attempts to open a business checking account. Customer identity documents have been received but not yet verified.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: FinCEN Customer Identification Program requires KYC completion before account opening. AGR enforces this at the agent layer — not as a UI toggle a developer can bypass.

scenarios.name: CTR filing blocked for sub-threshold transaction
scenarios.narrative: Compliance agent attempts to file a Currency Transaction Report for a $7,500 cash transaction. FinCEN CTR threshold is $10,000.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Filing CTRs for sub-threshold transactions wastes FinCEN resources and flags structuring patterns incorrectly. AGR enforces the $10k threshold as policy.

scenarios.name: Account freeze requires compliance approval
scenarios.narrative: Fraud detection agent identifies suspicious activity and attempts to immediately freeze a customer account. Account actions affecting customer access require supervisor approval.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Wrongly frozen accounts trigger Reg E disputes and customer churn. AGR routes freeze decisions to a human while the agent flags the activity — best of both worlds.

scenarios.name: Credit limit increase blocked — exceeds 3x multiplier
scenarios.narrative: Customer service agent attempts to increase a credit card limit from $5,000 to $20,000 (4x) based on income change. Exceeds the bank's risk policy of 3x maximum increase.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Sudden large credit limit increases are a key indicator of account takeover fraud. AGR enforces the 3x policy before the agent touches the core banking system.

scenarios.name: Mortgage blocked — DTI exceeds 43% QM threshold
scenarios.narrative: Mortgage origination agent processes a home loan application with 47% debt-to-income ratio. CFPB Qualified Mortgage rules cap DTI at 43%.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Originating non-QM mortgages above 43% DTI removes CFPB safe harbor protection. AGR blocks this before it reaches the underwriting system.

scenarios.name: SWIFT message modification blocked after cutoff
scenarios.narrative: Payments agent attempts to modify a SWIFT MT103 message after the 4pm daily SWIFT cutoff. Post-cutoff modifications cannot be recalled and create settlement fails.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Post-cutoff SWIFT modifications cause Nostro breaks and correspondent bank penalties. AGR enforces the cutoff as a hard policy — no exceptions at the agent level.

scenarios.name: Nostro adjustment requires dual approval
scenarios.narrative: Reconciliation agent identifies a $150,000 Nostro account break and attempts to post a manual adjustment. Nostro adjustments are high-risk and require dual control.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Unauthorized Nostro adjustments are how rogue trading gets hidden. AGR enforces dual control on every manual adjustment — the agent can identify breaks, not resolve them alone.

scenarios.name: Customer data export blocked — no legal basis
scenarios.narrative: Analytics agent attempts to export customer transaction history for a third-party marketing partnership. No GDPR legal basis has been established.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: GDPR Art.6 requires a lawful basis for every data processing activity. AGR blocks exports with no legal basis — before any data crosses a system boundary.

scenarios.name: Overdraft protection allowed — opted in, under limit
scenarios.narrative: Transaction processing agent applies overdraft protection to a $200 shortfall. Customer has opted in and the amount is within the $1,000 policy limit.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: AGR enables automation for pre-approved, low-risk operations. The agent applies overdraft protection instantly — governance does not mean everything stops for review.

scenarios.name: Card data write blocked — not tokenized
scenarios.narrative: Payments agent attempts to write raw card numbers to a transaction processing table. PCI-DSS prohibits storing PANs outside tokenized systems.
scenarios.leadership_talking_point: Storing unmasked PANs outside PCI scope triggers mandatory breach notification and card brand fines. AGR blocks the write — the agent cannot accidentally create PCI scope.
